versions.changelog:
Yuanbao 1.0.0 initial release:

- Enables group interaction with full @mention capability via reply text; no special formatting required.
- Provides tools for querying group info, searching members, and sending private messages (DM/私信), including media file support.
- Adds clear workflow instructions for @mentioning users and sending DMs within Yuanbao groups.
- Designed for concise, natural replies; avoids unnecessary explanations about messaging mechanics.
- Includes handling for multiple user candidates and integration with groups ("派") and various member roles (user, yuanbao_ai, bot).
